title: Add type annotations to public functions
description:
mypy --strict reports 50 type errors in server.py:

- Helper functions _bool(v) and _int(v) lack parameter type annotations (lines 21, 27)
- session_dict(s), window_dict(w), pane_dict(p) lack parameter types (lines 36, 46, 56)
- get_session(), get_window(), resolve_pane() lack return type annotations (lines 68, 75, 83)
- All route handlers lack return type annotations (lines 138, 162, etc.)
- dict without type arguments at lines 36, 46, 56, 170, 209, 251

Consider using libtmux type stubs or typing.Any for external library objects.
